notes.title: ODINFALL Update 0.6.0 is now LIVE | New character, Achievements, Looping mode!
notes.notes:
Vikings, it’s here! 
The biggest [b]ODINFALL[/b] update yet! [b]Patch 0.6.0[/b] is now available on the [b]main branch[/b].

We’ve been working hard on bringing major new features and improvements to your post-apocalyptic playground, and today we’re thrilled to share them with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/21ff9c1b1df1a55da23077fb736e872de5b7c5bc.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Highlights[/h2]

[h3]New Looping Mode[/h3]
Replacing the Infinite Mode, Looping introduces a new system of difficulty scaling after defeating the final boss of the map you're on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/ad4f2a73be04ef1e9a062be489aefce9385e1f2c.gif[/img]

[h3]New Playable Character[/h3]
Meet Trulls, the Trapper!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/796bcea0b60f3ea813ff17c1e88e9478c86502e7.gif[/img]

[h3]Difficulty Settings[/h3]
Tailor the challenge to your playstyle with new customizable difficulty options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/a74502adfa947fa898c6f56f24b430f06ad40af1.gif[/img]

[h3]New Weapons & Mods[/h3]
Expand your arsenal with powerful new tools of destruction and strategic upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/0f6d197edd7aff3e4bc4e49a5943278db4f9e4e4.gif[/img]

[h3]Steam Achievements[/h3]
Unlock and track your progress with official Steam achievements!

As always, we’d love to hear your thoughts, join the conversation over on our Discord. :D

See you in the Loop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/32ca599f21f9f86421f6dc0172860457a3a51df9.png[/img]

[h2]Patch 0.6.0 Notes[/h2]
[h3]GENERAL[/h3]
Added: Steam achievements,
Added: automatic item scrapping,

notes.title: ODINFALL Patch 0.5.7 is Now on the Experimental Branch! | TWITCH INTEGRATION
notes.notes:
Vikings, it’s time to test something special!

[b]Patch 0.5.7[/b] is now [b]live[/b] on the [b]Experimental Branch![/b] 

This update brings [b]new weapons[/b], [b]gameplay improvements[/b], and a huge new feature: [b]Twitch Integration[/b]!

Want your chat to shape your run? Then this one’s for you.
([i]Full patch notes below[/i])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/82624138a710f4f07f6e3f5e8431aa5fe6af0638.png[/img]
[h1]Twitch Integration - How It Works[/h1]
[h2]Enabling Twitch Integration[/h2]
[olist][*] Opt into the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2154240/announcements/detail/512953841353752651]Experimental Branch[/url] ([i]more info on this below[/i]).
[*] Select the [b]"Twitch"[/b] option in the [b]settings[/b].
[*] [b]Log into your Twitch account[/b] to connect it to your game.
[*] [b]Hit play[/b], start the stream and you're [b]ready to go![/b][/olist]
[h2]How It Works[/h2]
When [b]entering a new node[/b], a [b]Twitch poll[/b] will begin.
[h3]Poll A: Weapon vs Weapon ([i]75% chance[/i])[/h3] 
[b]Viewers vote on 2 weapons[/b]; [b]winning weapon[/b] drops for the player.

[h3]Poll B: Enemy vs Run modifier ([i]25% chance[/i])[/h3] 
Viewers vote on an enemy [b]OR[/b] a new run modifier.
-> If an [b]Enemy wins the poll[/b], the winning enemy will spawn on [b]Floor 3[/b] in one of three forms ([i]1x Legendary enemy, 6x Elite enemies, or 20x Normal enemies[/i]).
-> If a [b]Modifier wins the poll[/b], the winning modifier is enabled for the [b]rest of the node[/b].

[h3]Enemies also appear with Viewer names[/h3]
[b]Chance per enemy type[/b]
-> [b]Normal[/b]: 1 in 300
-> [b]Elite[/b]: 1 in 40
-> [b]Legendary[/b]: 1 in 2

Viewers who are [b]subbed to your channel[/b] have [b]stronger stats[/b] and [b]drop 2 chests[/b] when defeated ([i]non-subs drop 1[/i]).
Finally, whenever a [b]viewer is defeated[/b] in game there is a small [b]in game notification[/b] as well as a [b]chat announcement[/b].

We’re eager to hear your feedback on this update! [url=https://discord.gg/Qx4WjqDZhA]Join us on Discord[/url] or over in the Steam forums and tell us what you think and to [b]share your ODINFALL streams[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/32ca599f21f9f86421f6dc0172860457a3a51df9.png[/img]

[h2]How to Access the Experimental Branch[/h2]
For more info on the [b]Experimental Branch[/b] and how to access it, check out the full rundown here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2154240/view/512953841353752650?snr=1_5_9_
[h1]Experimental Patch 0.5.7 Notes[/h1]
[h2]GENERAL[/h2]
• Twitch implementation – Let the audience decide loot and enemies!
• The pause screen now shows your current location and total kills.
• New animations for boss deaths
• New animations for cryo chamber pickups.
• Infinite areas scaling has been adjusted: enemies now gain +5 HP per floor 
• For elite enemies this is doubled, and for legendary enemies this is quadrupled
[h2]WEAPONS[/h2]
• [b]NEW: Cluster Launcher[/b]
• [b]NEW: Heavy Ballista[/b]

notes.title: Introducing the ODINFALL Experimental Branch & Patch 0.5.3!
notes.notes:
Greetings, survivors!

We’re excited to introduce a new way for you to get an early look at upcoming changes - our [b]Experimental Branch[/b]! This system will allow us to test new updates with the community before rolling them into the main game, helping us fine-tune balance, fix potential issues, and make [b]ODINFALL[/b] the best it can be.

[h2]How the Experimental Branch Works[/h2]
Once a week, we’ll launch an [b]ODINFALL[/b] patch into the [b]Experimental Branch[/b]. Based on how it performs, we’ll then incorporate it into the [b]main branch[/b] later that week.

[h2]How to Access the Experimental Branch[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Open the game and go to Settings
[*] Navigate to Extra and select Experimental Branch
[*] You’ll receive a pop-up asking you to confirm your choice
[*] Restart your game and allow any updates to install
[*] Relaunch, and you’re in!
[/olist]
Keep in mind that the [b]Experimental Branch[/b] uses a separate save from the main game to prevent incompatibility issues. If you ever want to switch back, just return to the main branch - your original save will still be there waiting for you!

We’d love to hear your feedback on changes in the Experimental Branch, so be sure to share your thoughts with us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/jmhRWFTzzU]Discord[/url] or the Steam forums!

[h2]ODINFALL Patch 0.5.3[/h2]
[h3]GENERAL[/h3]
- Camera: Zoomout from last patch reduced from 80 to 50 pixels  
- Marketplace: Added selling altar  
- When a weapon challenge is completed the unlocked weapon drops  
- Random Loki Comments are now rarer  
- Act Panels now show a skull symbol for each unique mythic enemy currently enabled by the runmodifiers  
- Taking the hatch back to homebase after defeating a boss now shows that boss on the deathscreen instead of unknown  
- Stationary enemies no longer spawn on top of the blue exit hatch  
- In addition to the mouse, homebase tutorial popups can now be advanced using the keyboard  
- If an enemy limb kills you the owner of that limb is shown as the killer  
- Completing a weapon challenge now drops the weapon as a reward mid-run  
- The weapons on the first floor of the training grounds are now spawned by ammo category, and ordered by weapon tier  
- Fixed bug: Water droplets could spawn on open exit hatches in the sewer  
- Fixed bug: Pickups could sometimes fly away during cutscenes

[h3]WEAPONS[/h3]
[b]Added Thermal Rifle  
Added Laser Rifle  
Added Flak Cannon[/b]

- Aim Spread reduced from 28 to 26 degrees

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.5.1.5
notes.notes:
Thanks for all your feedback so far! Here's the latest fixes and polishes that have been added to ODINFALL: 

[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Detaching mods is faster, and dropping weapons is slower
[*]Chests open faster
[*]Gold: pickup range increased from 45 to 55
[*]Gold: can be picked up before it lands on the ground
[*]Gold: remains on ground 5 seconds longer
[*]Pickups: remaining duration paused while in cutscene
[*]Loot: Weapon tier can't be more than 2 lvls lower than the node's loot lvl.
[*]Elite enemies no longer appear in the first area of the first node visited
[*]Number of enemies reduced slightly in most of act 1 (the desert). Particularly on floors with legendary bosses.
[*]Pickups: blink more often
[*]Marketplace: all 3 shopkeepers always appear
[*]Marketplace: Mod Shopkeeper and Upgrade Card Shopkeeper swap places
[*]Marketplace: Weapons sold increased from 3 to 5
[*]Marketplace: blue key moved closer to blue hatch
[*]Fimbulwinter: Ice Cage rework. OLD: 100% chance of rune mod. NEW: 40% chance of rune mod, 50% chance of 2 chests, 10% chance of heart
[*]Fimbulwinter: Ice Cage no longers fires freezing projectiles in the time between being touched and disappearing
[*]Fimbulwinter: Ice Cage repelling power decreased
[*]Fimbulwinter: Snow on ground opacity reduced from 1 to 0.1
[*]Fixed bug: Loki called all your weapons terrible, no matter the weapon tier
[*]Fixed bug: Progress could sometimes not be made on Weapon Challenges until the player died one additional time after unlocking the Weapon Challenge Board
[*]Fixed bug: Some Weapon Challenges completed even after their time limit had passed
[*]Fixed bug: Boss Victory Music did not respect volume slider
[*]Fixed bug: "AREA CLEAR" obstructed gun names in the description bubble
[*]Fixed bug: Skill Tree notificiation icon appeared before the Skill Tree was unlocked
[*]Fixed bug: users could not take Steam screenshots
[*]Fixed bug: Legendary Cannibal sometimes did not have a HP bar
[*]"Active Challenges" text removed when all challenges complete
[/list]
 
[h3][b]Characters[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Character max level is shown in Cryo Chamber and Skill Tree

[b]Britta the Cyberserker[/b]
[*]Slower idle animation speed

[b]Gustaf the Ghost[/b]
[*]HP increased from 6 to 7
[*]Movement speed reduced from 5 to 4.5
[/list]

[h3][b]Weapons [/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added: Stabby Knife
[*]Added: Scoped Revolver
[*]Added: Laser Burster
[*]Magnum Bullet damage increased from 7 to 10 (affects all revolver type weapons)

[b]Axe[/b]
[*]Damage increased from 7 to 10

[b]Spike Club[/b]
[*]Damage increased from 12 to 16

[b]Shortsword[/b]
[*]Damage increased from 7 to 10
[*]Cooldown reduced from 32 to 28

[b]Greatsword[/b]
[*]Cooldown reduced from 75 to 60
[*]Burst cooldown reduced from 15 to 10

[b]Road Pig[/b]
[*]Tier changed from 4 to 3
[*]Firing sound volume increased, pitch increased

[b]Blaster/Assault Blaster[/b]
[*]Projectile speed reduced from 6 to 5
[*]Time between blast explosions increased from 3 to 4
[*]Blast explosion volume lowered[/list]


[h3][b]Enemies [/b][/h3]
[list][*]Regular fire, blue fire, and pink fire can be destroyed with melee attacks

[b]Ice Fairy[/b]
[*]Removed: Proximity Frostball attack
[*]Removed: Fly

[b]Bluetooth Bandit[/b]

notes.title: An Update on Co-op in ODINFALL's Early Access
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings!

Huge thanks to everyone who took part in the recent [b]Co-op Network Test[/b]. Your feedback was incredibly helpful and gave us some much-needed insight into the mode’s performance.
 
Unfortunately, we found that the co-op feature wasn’t as stable as we had initially thought. Our priority as a small indie team is to deliver a smooth and polished gaming experience for all our players. So we have made the difficult decision to launch into [b]Early Access without [/b]the originally planned [b]co-op mode[/b]. At this time it is best for us to concentrate our efforts on the [b]single-player mode[/b]. 
 
We’re dedicated to making [b]Odinfall[/b] the most awesome game it can be, and we’re so grateful for your ongoing support and understanding.
 
[b]Odinfall[/b] is shaping up to be an action-packed, chaotic adventure, and we can’t wait to share more news about what’s coming next very, very soon!
 
Thanks again for being such an amazing community. If you have any questions please do let us know and we’ll do our best to answer.

- Ember Paw Games <3

notes.title: ODINFALL Early Access Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings Vikings!

As we get closer to [b]Early Access[/b], we wanted to let you know that we’ve done a bit of housekeeping and updated our [b]Steam Early Access FAQ[/b], which you can find on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2154240/Odinfall/]Odinfall’s Steam page[/url]. It tells you everything you need to know about how Odinfall will spend its time in [b]Early Access[/b] and what to expect from this 3 month period. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/b890009053f8926b273cce2a624808211c65b161.gif[/img]

We want to reassure you that none of this means anything will be changing in terms of content, and that the version that launches into [b]Early Access[/b] will be content complete, with just some polishing and balancing to stabilize. 

Ultimately you, the community, will be the most important driving force in making Odinfall the best it can be through [b]Early Access[/b] feedback, especially in co-op mode. You may see a few bugs as we iron them out, so please do let us know what you find. We cannot wait to hear what you think! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/4bfd3ca0f2b5c31aab1aa60714abaaab03b50551.gif[/img]

Please check out the full FAQ on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2154240/Odinfall/]Odinfall Steam page[/url] if you’d like more info. 

And make sure to [url=https://discord.com/invite/jmhRWFTzzU]join the Discord![/url]

Best regards,
The Odinfall Team

notes.title: Spicy Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Over [b]3000[/b] of you have played the new demo!

Thank you to everyone who has played! We hope you love it!

But… If you haven't played yet… Go do that right now?!

Especially now we have some [b]experimental[/b] updates below!

[b]Variety is the spice of death![/b]
To add a little variety, the second level of every node is now smaller and has fewer enemies than the first and third areas.

[b]Loot boxes (not really!)[/b]
The second area of every node now has a 1 in 12 chance of being a Secret Cache! These areas have no enemies and 4 times the chests.

[b]We killed the kill Screen[/b]
Killing the final boss now no longer crashes the game… Loki made that happen the first time.
